newsitem.title: USA: Chile buys Escravos, Oriente crude for January.
newsitem.headline: Chile buys Escravos, Oriente crude for January.

text.p: Chile's state oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) bought a total of three cargoes of Nigerian Escravos and Ecuadoran Oriente for early January in its latest purchase tender, trade sources said Thursday.
ENAP bought a cargo of one million barrels of Escravos and two cargoes of 400,000 barrels each of Oriente.

Market sources said the Escravos was sold by Chevron at Dated Brent plus 25 cents a barrel fob, and the Oriente was sold by Ecuadoran Tripetrol at January West Texas Intermediate minus $4.25 a barrel fob.
Separately, Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol late last week sold 400,000 barrels of South Blend crude at Jan WTI minus $2.35 fob, traders said.
The unconfirmed buyer was Exxon which would use the crude for blending at its refinery in El Salvador.
